admission.justification: A later apply must not overwrite a target statement or import another leaf history as if it were the recovery leaf own answers. Transitive closure, conflicts and no-history payload/public-apply assertions prove this boundary, distinct from general committed-pair attribution.

applicability: Transitive source-record dependency carryover and the no-source-history-import boundary.
conditions: Selected sidecars name realizes/proves invariants and record-reference IDs; record members/supersedes/nonroute links are traversed transitively.
Only absent or exact same-path resumable record members may be carried; differing held records require the curator writer.
Source history rows are reading aids only and never payloads.
exclusions: No source history row becomes the recovery leaf governing row.
Record Markdown companions travel when present in the source; the current record schema allows a JSON-only record.
Partial/unconverted indexes do not establish record absence; conflicts refuse carrying the candidate even after explicit review selection.
Clean existing record differences are never overwritten; this is stricter than document replace_existing policy.

evidence: Frozen generation3 source inspection; no new execution or acceptance.

statement: Missing transitive records travel with the selected documents, differing records are never overwritten, and source history is only a reading aid.
